subject: ARLO SEO — Weekly Pulse — 2026-08-07
html:
Week 10 Pulse

Shipped since last pulse (2026-07-31): the Month 1 review (2026-08-01, which also fixed the standing SE Ranking rank-tracking gap by creating project askarlo.app and queuing the first position checks), /connect/google-business-profile-mcp (2026-08-03, closes the 6-Google-source connector matrix), and the "How to Set Up a Claude MCP Server" blog post (2026-08-06, plus an llms.txt fix). The headline this week: real SERP position data is in for the first time — see below.

Leads proxy (GA4 conversions)

Pending — GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) is firing, but this sandbox still has no outbound GA4 API access. Waiting on the scheduled data Action (12-week-strategy.md Week 8) to backfill this row.

Ranking movement

First full week of daily position checks is in for the askarlo.app SE Ranking project (site_id 12704162, Google US) — 7 consecutive daily checks, 2026-08-01 through 2026-08-07, across all 22 tracked keywords. Result: 0 of 22 keywords have a measurable position (all still outside the top 100) on every single day checked. There's no week-over-week trend yet since this is the first week real checks have run, so "last wk" and "now" are the same for every row below.

Context, not an alarm: this is expected for a domain SE Ranking itself scores at domain_trust: 4 (baseline, 1 referring domain) in its first ~5 weeks of indexation, with 12 pages/posts shipped total and no off-page link-building done yet. It does mean Month 2 KPI #1 ("first measured position for ≥15 of 22 keywords") is not on track at the one-week mark — worth watching over the next 2-3 pulses rather than reacting to week 1. Search-demand context (not rank, re-pulled live this session): claude mcp server continues climbing, now 1,300/mo (was 810/mo at the 2026-07-31 pulse, 735/mo before that) — the fastest-growing tracked term by far.

Traffic vs last week

Pending / unchanged. SE Ranking's own organic index (getDomainOverviewByCountry, US) still shows zero indexed organic or paid keywords for askarlo.app. Backlinks (getBacklinksSummary, domain mode): 2 backlinks / 1 referring domain, still only from futurlabs.dev (the sister portfolio site's existing project link) — no change since 2026-08-01. AI search overview (getAiSearchOverview, US): still null brand_presence, 0 link_presence, 0 ai_opportunity_traffic — unchanged from every prior pulse.

Anything broken?

No build/pipeline regressions. SEO Report Email Action: 17 of 18 runs green all-time (same single failure as every prior pulse — the very first shakeout run on 2026-07-04, before the pipeline worked end-to-end); all 3 sessions since the last pulse (2026-08-01, 2026-08-03, 2026-08-06) sent and archived cleanly, each with a clean npm run build + npm run lint per the worklog.

catalog.ts drift has now blown past 2 more of its own stated ETAs. Re-checked src/lib/connectors/catalog.ts this session: hubspot and mailerlite were both eta'd "July 2026" — that month is now over with no status flip; meta_ads ("May 2026") is 3 months overdue. salesforce/pipedrive still waitlist; gohighlevel/clarity/gtm still absent from the catalog entirely. Open since 2026-07-20 (now 6+ sessions), still needs a human product-owner call before any of these 9 connectors can get a public marketing page.

Off-page Phase 1 (Smithery.ai, Glama.ai, mcp.so, awesome-mcp-servers, AlternativeTo, SaaSHub) is still 0 of 6 — flagged as the single most overdue item since Week 4, still blocked on a human with a browser (this sandbox has no outbound HTTP).

Reading the week

Content production stayed on pace — 2 shipped sessions since the last pulse (GBP connector page closing the Google-source matrix, an MCP-server how-to blog post) plus the Month 1 review that finally got rank tracking wired up. But the first real ranking data this routine has ever had access to is a clean baseline, not a signal to celebrate: zero of the 22 tracked keywords are ranked anywhere in the top 100 after a full week of daily checks. That's normal for a ~5-week-old, DA-4 domain with 1 referring domain and no off-page work done yet — but it does mean the plan's two structural blockers (off-page link-building still at 0/6, and the catalog.ts human decision now overdue on 3 connectors) matter more than ever, since content alone hasn't moved rank yet. Next pulse should have a real week-over-week comparison instead of a same-day baseline.
